name: multiplayer-agent-workspace
description: A shared AI agent room — one conversation, multiple people, one agent that knows who said what.

scripts.build:relay: npm run build -w @mpa/protocol && npm run build -w @mpa/relay
scripts.build:workspace: npm run build -w @mpa/protocol && npm run build -w @mpa/relay-client && npm run build -w @mpa/workspace-core && npm run build -w @mpa/workspace-host
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w multiplayer-agent
